title: Kenji without the screwdriver
caption: Jørgen: "could you redo him without the skrewdriver ... base portraits should NEVER have props". Only his right arm (image left) is repainted: it hangs empty at his side, the hand below the frame. Faces, hair, shirt, framing and FACE.kenji are unchanged, and all three faces share the same new arm. Installed in the game and art/approved/kenji/. The pocket snack and the sleeve sticky note are still on him (not in his hands; say if they should go too).
